guitar.notes: Pre-Pearl Jam band; Stone Gossard's Gibson-based gear is loosely documented but not singularly iconic for this specific band, low confidence.

tone.target: thick 90s alt-rock crunch with chewy mids
tone.profile: thick 90s alt-rock crunch with chewy mids
tone.summary: A classic British stack simulation (UK 45) with a light OD boost and Chorus for thickening, optimized for thick alt-rock mids.

rig.name: Mother Love Bone - Stardog Champion - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and stray noise.
Provide light, gritty overdrive and boost the mids for alt-rock crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general choice; Blues OD or Comp could also work but Green OD offers better grit control.

blocks.purpose: Keep the gain stage clean to maintain natural sustain and avoid metal tones.
Simulate the classic British Plexi/Marshall tone required for alt-rock grit and forward mids.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is the best fit for the specified 'Plexi/Marshall' sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound (4x12) to complement the UK 45 amp model.
Fine-tune the frequency response, emphasizing mids and tightening the low end.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for more precise mid-range sculpting than EQ 1.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle thickening and width to the rhythm tone without sounding overly processed.
blocks.gap: Chorus is ideal for adding 'chewy' texture in alt-rock settings.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: A moderate delay adds dimension without distracting from the core crunch tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide natural ambience and glue the sound together.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is generally best for alt-rock to maintain clarity.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism with a specific British IR for better alt-rock bite.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic British crunch tone and mid-focus.
